sloka: कलशीम् अपविद्ध्य अन्या प्रसुप्ता भाति भामिनी ।वसन्ते पुष्प शबला माला इव परिमार्जिता ॥५-१०-४६॥
transliteration: kalaśīm apaviddhya anyā prasuptā bhāti bhāminī ।vasante puṣpa śabalā mālā iva parimārjitā ॥5-10-46॥

translations.english: Another lovely lady was fast asleep, having turned a goblet of water aside, yet another lay like a garland of variegated flowers in spring season.
